schema.description: One analyte's result from one blood or urine draw, as a pathology report printed it, read into a records file. Written by scripts/extract-acl-pathology.py for Australian Clinical Labs PDFs and by hand readings of other reports. value, range and unit are the report's text; value_num and flagged are derived from it by the extraction.

analyte.description: The analyte's name as printed in the result row, with the report's flag asterisks removed and spaces collapsed by the extraction.

collected.description: When the sample was drawn, reformatted by the extraction from the report's DD/MM/YY to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in Sydney local time. A history column with no printed time takes one from the extractor's --known-times, or 00:00. This is the fact time.

collection_type.description: The glucose table's collection type column (such as fasting or random), as printed. Script only, glucose rows only.

fasting.description: Whether the draw was fasting. Derived by the extraction: from the report's "Fasting status" line, or for glucose rows from collection_type. Absent when the report says nothing.

flag_as_printed.description: The flag mark the report printed in the value column before the value, kept as printed. Hand readings only, written so far on rows printed against status_bands, where one asterisk and two asterisks both occur; the report prints no key, so what two marks say beyond one is not stated.

flagged.description: True when the report marks the value as outside its range with an asterisk. Derived by the extraction from the printed mark; never false, absent when unmarked.

id.description: Identity, chosen at extraction and deterministic from the content: the lab's prefix (acl or healthscope), the lab number, and the analyte as a slug, with a non-blood specimen prefixed (urine-albumin).

lab.description: The lab that did the work. The script writes "Australian Clinical Labs" for every record, a constant rather than text read from the report; hand readings write the lab's name as the report gives it.

lab_number.description: The lab's number for the draw, as printed (7 or 8 digits), kept as text. History columns quote earlier draws under their own numbers.

note.description: A note by whoever read the report about this result (a row printed with no value, a doubtful digit). Not report text.

panel.description: The panel heading the result was printed under, in the report's capitals.

range.description: The reference range as printed in brackets after the value, brackets removed and spaces collapsed. Report text, never parsed.

source_note.description: Where a result came from when it is not the report's own draw: written by a hand reading when only a later report's history column prints the row.

specimen.description: The specimen as printed, usually in the report's capitals.

status_bands.description: The status table a report prints in place of a single reference range, condensed by the reader into one line: each band's label and bound, separated by semicolons, with the unit once at the end. The reader's condensation, labels shortened, not the report's layout. Hand readings only.

time_unknown.description: True when the report printed the collection day but no time, so the 00:00 in collected is a placeholder. Written by scripts/extract-acl-pathology.py; absent otherwise.

unit.description: The unit as printed after the range. The script tidies the spacing in powers of ten (x10^9/L); otherwise report text.

value.description: The result exactly as the report printed it, kept as text, including a comparator when there is one ("< 0.5"). This is the report's lexeme.

value_num.description: The value as a number, parsed from value by the extraction (script or hand reading). Absent when value carries a comparator such as < or >, because the report gave a bound, not a number.
